sequences.description: Attack: role with empty claim_constraints may skip intended claim validation and over-grant policies. Control role requires dept=finance; attacker role has same audience but empty claim_constraints. Attacker JWT lacks dept claim but should not get privileged policy.
sequences.invariant_hypothesis: I5: If claim constraints are empty/misinterpreted, Vault may grant privileged policies without enforcing upstream intent (dept=finance), allowing access beyond BrokerPolicy(config).

sequences.description: Attack hypothesis: If the JWT auth mount is configured without bound_issuer, Vault may accept tokens from an unintended issuer as long as signature and audience validate, causing authorization to exceed upstream intent (issuer binding missing). Control token uses intended iss; attacker token uses different iss but same aud and gets same privileged policy, enabling secret read.
sequences.invariant_hypothesis: I5: Effective permissions must be bound to upstream intent (including issuer). A token from an unintended issuer must not be able to obtain the same privileged policies and access as a token from the intended issuer.
